message:
The users API test now passes (`npm test`: 1 pass, 0 fail).

The test failed with `unknown column users.full_name`. Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. I changed the API to use `fullname` in both places, which is a two-line change.

I left the migrations alone. 001 is already applied in production and is owned by the DBA team, so the database column stays `fullname`.
